video_title: Field Agronomy Clinic: Proper Spray Technique for Foliar Blights
technique_title: Underside Canopy Spray Penetration & Nozzle Geometry
key_technique: Walk at a steady 3 km/h pace; orient the hollow-cone nozzle 30° upward to penetrate the dense lower canopy. Fungal spores of Alternaria germinate primarily on the humid abaxial (underside) leaf surface.
Disinfect pruning shears in 70% alcohol; snip all leaves within 30 cm of ground level to eliminate soil-splash inoculum.

video_title: Paddy Field Scouting for Spindle Lesions & Neck Blast
technique_title: Scouting Spindle Lesions on Flag Leaves
key_technique: Inspect flag leaves early in the morning before dew evaporates; check for diamond/spindle shaped lesions with white center.
